cues.text: For years, students have had to adapt to the lesson.
Memorize a formula.
Follow the steps.
Move on — even when it never clicks.
What if the lesson could adapt instead?
Why Math begins teaching, listens to the student,
and changes the next explanation.
Here are two simulated students.
Both fourteen.
Both starting from the same math idea.
Student A needs the words explained.
Student B has a different misunderstanding.
One AI teacher responds to what each student actually says.
It does not see their hidden test profiles.
The same teacher works in Korean, too.
Questions are not failures.
When a learner is unsure, the lesson explains rather than rushing ahead.
Some ideas are easier to see.
Add an apple.
Take it away. Now the basket is empty.
That quantity has a name: zero.
Your Living Textbook grows automatically,
saving the explanations, questions,
and what still needs checking —
not inventing mastery scores.
Same mathematics.
Different minds. A path that adapts to you.
Explore Why Math on GitHub.
